faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Udaipur Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Assistant position at IIM Udaipur is 10th October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the essential qualifications for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a motivation to pursue a Ph.D. in Marketing, a strong interest in qualitative research, and excellent English communication skills. Prior training in qualitative methods is also required.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial Application Review followed by Shortlisting of eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for this Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The position of Research Assistant at IIM Udaipur is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q6. Which department is hiring for this Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Marketing Area at IIM Udaipur, with a specific focus on qualitative research methods.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Research Assistant in Marketing Area at IIM Udaipur.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any desirable qualifications for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, a background in Anthropology/Sociology or relevant qualitative research experience, and fluency in Indian languages other than English are considered desirable.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official IIM Udaipur website or the provided application link before the last date.
